DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 111 s. 2022 October 4, 2022 Hon. ESTEBAN EVAN B. CONTRERAS Governor Province of Capiz Office of the Provincial Governor Capiz Provincial Capitol, Roxas City Dear Governor Contreras: This refers to your Letter dated March 21, 2022, requesting for this Department's opinion on whether or not the Sangguniang Panlalawigan's action on deferring the confirmation of appointment of the Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator pending the passage of the 2022 Annual Appropriation is valid. Per your letter, the Provincial Government of Capiz operates on a reenacted budget by reason ofthe failure of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (SP) to pass the 2022 Annual Budget. However, the SP passed Resolution No. 712, series of 2022, deferring the confirmation of the appointment of the Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator at the Provincial Planning and Development Office. Hence, the subject query. Section 323 of the Local Government Code provides for the consequence in case the Sanggunian fails to enact its annual appropriation, to wit: SECTION 323. Failure to Enact the Annual Appropriations. — In case the sanggunian concerned fails to pass the ordinance authorizing the annual appropriations at the beginning of the ensuing fiscal year, it shall continue to hold sessions without additional remuneration for its members until such ordinance is approved. and no other business may be taken up during such sessions. If the sanggunian still fails to enact such ordinance after ninety (90) days from the beginning of the fiscal year, the ordinance authorizing the appropriations of the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and shall remain in force and effect until the ordinance authorizing the proposed appropriations is passed by the sanggunian concerned. However, only the annual appropriations for salaries and wages of existing positions, statutory and contractual obligations, and essential Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

operating expenses authorized in the annual and supplemental budgets for the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and disbursement of funds shall be in accordance therewith. xxxx Accordingly, based on the above provision, the Department opines that the phrase "no other business may be taken up during such sessions" only refers to the sessions specifically conducted for the purpose of approving the appropriation ordinance. The Sanggunian, despite its failure to timely approve its appropriation ordinance is not precluded to conduct sessions to tackle matters necessary for the effective and efficient operations of the local government unit and for the delivery of basic services to their constituents. As to the act of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan on deferring the confirmation of appointment of the Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator at the Provincial Planning and Development Office, the Department's opinion must be qualified. It is to be emphasized that Section 323 states that when the LGU is operating on a reenacted budget, only the annual appropriations for salaries and wages of existing positions, statutory and contractual obligations, and essential operating expenses are deemed reenacted. In DILG Legal Opinion No. 7 series of 2016, dated February 9, 2016 it was -clarified that no distinction is made by law on the phrase "existing positions". Hence, the legal maxim "when the law does not distinguish, we must not distinguish finds application. Accordingly, appropriations for salaries and wages of existing positons, whether filled- up or vacant, are deemed re-enacted following Section 323 of the LGC. Relatively, the Department opines that the act of SP in deferring the confirmation of the appointment of Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator thru Resolution No. 712, series of 2022 is proper if such position is non-existent or only created during the current fiscal year. Local Budget Circular No. 112 with subject "Budget Operations Manual for Local Govemment Units", 2016 Edition, issued by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) provided that one of the disadvantages of a reenacted budget is that there will be no creation of positions. On the other hand, if the said position is already existing, then the deferment of confirming the appointment of the Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator, granting that he/she is qualified, is improper. This opinion is being rendered based on the facts presented and without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you.
